item.title: Rolling Domestic on Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County Leads to Stalking Charges

item.title: Governor Shapiro Vows to Use State Power to Block Proposed ICE Facilities in Berks and Schuylkill Counties
item.description: Gov. Josh Shapiro on Thursday said he is firmly opposed to two proposed federal immigration detention facilities planned for Berks and Schuylkill counties and vowed to use Pennsylvania’s legal and regulatory authority to try to stop them.
